_note: Santa's Rocket Run (concept). Same schema as assets/hitboxes.json. Column pieces at top level; check with tools/check_santa_continuity.py

columns._note: Santa column sets, same schema as hitboxes.json 'columns'. Tops = -body + -cap-bottom (ceilEdge = gap edge); bottoms = -cap-top + -body (floorEdge). 'anchor' explains what each top hangs from (David's rule: every top is anchored or genuinely in the sky). 'death' = Santa death type.

obs-lapland-aurora.anchor: the northern lights themselves: a curtain of aurora hanging out of the sky (no hard anchor needed, it IS the sky)

obs-lapland-sprucebough.anchor: a giant snowy spruce bough reaching down from the top edge: the brown trunk with needle tufts comes down, forks into a wide snow-laden branch, and icicles hang beneath it

obs-lapland-workshop.note: elf-workshop stone chimney, candy-stripe crown, wreath; smoke decorative
